text:
Alex Kim: incident-bot paged for high error-rate on hosted endpoint /v1/generate — seeing huge spike in upstream 502s and RTTs, customers complaining. rolling a page to oncall.
incident-bot: ALERT: service=inference-hosted env=prod metric=5xx_rate threshold=0.07 current=0.23 @oncall-sre
Oncall-sre: grabbing it. can someone paste the alert graphs?
Maria Chen: looks like region-us-west is getting a lot of traffic and failing over to region-us-east, which then hits capacity and starts failing back. I think routing policy is bouncing requests between variants.
Sanjay Patel: checking smart-routing logs. I see repeated failovers for model variant "redwoo-7b-q4" -> fallback "redwoo-7b-int8" then to replica in us-east, then clients retry. creating a quick grep.
Sanjay Patel: log snippet: `router: requestid=abc123 policy=smart-route region=us-west -> variant=redwoo-7b-q4 health=degraded -> failover=redwoo-7b-int8 -> forwarded=us-east-1` repeated hundreds of times in past 3m.
Julie Ramos: customer impact: PaymentBot (customer X) reports timeouts for some flows. CS pinged and wants ETA. Priya, can you coordinate customer comms after we have cause?
Priya Nair: on it. hold on msg for now.
Alex Kim: do we know why q4 variant degraded? recent rollout yesterday had tiny perf tweak but health checks passed.
Maria Chen: I think the health check sensitivity plus client-side aggressive retries is creating a fan-out. When smart-routing fails a request, the client sees a timeout and retries, then routing treats them as new requests and triggers failover again -> exponential amplification.
Oncall-sre: can we temporarily change routing policy to prefer local replica and disable cross-region failover? or set short-circuit for known failing variant?
Sanjay Patel: we can update policy config: set `max_failover_hops:1` and `regional_preference: true` for affected route. pushing to staging then prod. preparing patch.
Julie Ramos: we should also throttle incoming connection rate from suspect clients to break retry loop.
Alex Kim: agree. Also enable 429 for pathological retry patterns. we need to avoid impacting legitimate traffic.
Sanjay Patel: deploying policy change now. here's curl to rollout (internal API):
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/routing/update \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","max_failover_hops":1,"regional_preference":true}'
```
deploy-bot: started rollout job j-7823; estimated 20s per region.
incident-bot: NOTICE: policy update applied to region-us-west
Sanjay Patel: applied, verifying.
Maria Chen: after policy change I still see retries from clients flooding. but the routing bounce stops — traffic is now concentrated in us-west local replicas.
Oncall-sre: we need to shed load from overloaded replicas — enabling admission control and shedding non-SLA customers.
Alex Kim: enabling admission control on overloaded pool, applying short-term token-level throttles for free-tier keys and bursts. Patch in 30s.
deploy-bot: admission-control enabled on pool gpu-pool-4. Metrics show CPU/GPU util dropping from 95% to 78%.
Maria Chen: 5xx rate dropping but still higher than baseline. I can see a pattern: some clients do 3 retries with exponential backoff of 200ms -> 400ms -> 800ms which is too aggressive. we should add server-side retry budget enforcement.
Julie Ramos: Priya, CS wants to send an update: "We are mitigating an outage impacting text generation in US regions — engineers applied routing and throttles, some customers on free tiers may see 429s temporarily. We'll update in 30 minutes." ok to send?
Priya Nair: send it now. keep language calm.
Priya Nair: (sent) "We’re investigating degraded performance affecting text generation for a subset of US customers. Our engineers have applied mitigations and are monitoring — some low-priority traffic may see rate-limits to protect capacity. We’ll share another update at T+30."
Alex Kim: good. we should also blacklist the buggy model variant if it's root cause — I can roll an emergency config to prevent routing to redwoo-7b-q4 while we root cause.
Sanjay Patel: doing a soft-blacklist (route weight=0) for redwoo-7b-q4 now.
deploy-bot: route weight update applied for variant redwoo-7b-q4 => 0. Job j-7826.
Maria Chen: after soft-blacklist, failovers stopped completely. error-rate trending toward normal. looks like variant had regressions in KV cache that caused OOMs under certain prefix patterns.
Alex Kim: note for postmortem: identify model variant rollout windows and metrics we didn't have on the variant. also we need client library guidance to reduce aggressive retries.
Julie Ramos: agree. action items: 1) investigate root cause of redwoo-7b-q4 regressions with model owners 2) add server-side retry budget and per-key rate limiting 3) tweak smart-routing to include hysteresis and backoff counters 4) update client SDK to exponential-better-backoff defaults 5) customer comms follow-up.
Sanjay Patel: I'll own the routing hysteresis PR. Alex will own blacklist/playbook. Priya handles customer updates. Julie will write the incident slack summary.
Oncall-sre: handoff to next oncall in 15m. leaving monitoring alerts at higher sensitivity until model is validated.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity=sev2 start=1748254321 current_status=mitigated mitigations=route-limit,admission-control,variant-blacklist
Alex Kim: thumbs — good job team. Postmortem please within 48h. Also let's add a page to runbook: "If model variant causes cascading failover, immediate steps = blacklist variant, throttle incoming retries, enable admission control, inform CS." 
Priya Nair: CS update scheduled for T+30. I'll coordinate.
Julie Ramos: saving logs and flags for postmortem. closing communication loop with affected customers list and next steps.
Sanjay Patel: metrics look stable for 10m, leaving reduced thresholds on until we validate new variant in staging. I'll follow up tomorrow with more details.
Alex Kim: handing off to SRE for the watch. Oncall-sre, you're primary now.
Oncall-sre: acknowledged. watching graphs. will page if anything regresses.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: final-severity=sev2 duration=00:30:02 lead=Alex Kim responders=[Maria Chen,Sanjay Patel,Julie Ramos,Priya Nair,oncall-sre]
